title: Time-Zone-Ordered Spillover Networks: code
description: Python code for the paper 'Time-Zone-Ordered Spillover Networks for Forecasting Volatility in Global Technology Equities'. Includes the clock mask, the masked latent-graph forecaster, the leakage gate, the TVP-VAR connectedness estimator, the evaluation tests, the synthetic study and the figure script.
